title: unified-rollouts-enhanced-probing-staged-shadow-autorollback
author: Aisha Chen
description: Context: We need more robust safety guards when doing staged shadow and probing rollouts across model variants. Recent canary incidents showed the platform lacked fine-grained probing and automated rollback triggers for multi-stage shadow+canary flows. This PR extends the unified-rollouts subsystem to add: 1) a probing stage that gradually ramps synthetic shadow probes across varying traffic segments with configurable probing schedules, 2) composite metric matching for multi-metric rollbacks (latency, token-error-rate, hallucination-rate), 3) a staged shadow policy that can selectively route sampling traffic to new model variants for data collection without impacting live production routing, and 4) improved observability and e2e tests to reduce flakiness and ensure rollback correctness. What changed: - rollout/policy: added ProbingStage and StagedShadowPolicy objects (control-plane config parsing, validation and migration code) and integrated them into the existing rollout evaluation pipeline so that probing traffic can be scheduled before canary splits. - autorollback engine: extended the metric evaluator to accept composite metric expressions and to evaluate sliding-window deltas with configurable thresholds and recovery cooldowns. Implemented a safety backoff that escalates through probing->shadow->partial-canary->full-canary. - routing/runtime: new lightweight probe sampler that emits probe tokens to shadow replicas using existing shadow routing infrastructure; added consistent sampling seed to make probing reproducible for debug. - observability: added per-probe metrics (probe_count, probe_success_rate, probe_response_latency_p50/p95), composite_metric_alerts and tracing annotations for probing windows; updated dashboards and alert rules. - tests: added unit coverage for policy parsing and metric evaluation, integration tests that simulate staged shadow probing + canary progression, and an e2e smoke test that runs on the perf-canary lab. - migrations: config migration helper for existing rollouts to default to 'no-probing' to preserve behavior. Rollout strategy is opt-in via the new policy flags. Motivation: enable safe iterative model onboarding where we can gather telemetry from shadowed model variants with active probing and have deterministic rollback windows driven by multiple signals. This reduces blind-spots (e.g., when hallucination increases but latency stays acceptable) and provides clearer observability for platform and customer SREs. Backwards compatibility: changes are opt-in and include a migration path; existing rollouts behave the same unless ProbingStage is specified. Breaking changes: none. Rollout plan: merged to main behind a feature flag for 2 weeks, metrics monitored in staging and selected customer tenants before enabling by default. Links: Linear ENG-9876, ENG-11234; related PRs pr-61234 and pr-623501.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Overall looks good. Please add a short note in the migration script about defaulting existing rollout configs to 'no-probing' so customers aren't surprised.
Aisha Chen: Added migration note and a test that validates migration behavior (tests/integration/test_migration_no_probing.py).
Priya Natarajan: Can we make the composite metric expression language a little more restrictive to avoid surprising precedence? Suggest adding explicit parentheses in parsing and document examples.
Aisha Chen: Tightened parsing grammar and added examples to docs/rollouts/probing.md.
Evan Li: I saw a flake in test_staged_shadow_probe where sampling was non-deterministic on CI. Please add deterministic seed control for the probe sampler.
Aisha Chen: Exposed PROBE_SEED env var in the test harness and the sampler now defaults to a fixed seed when running under CI. Reran CI and green.
release_notes: Added opt-in probing/staged-shadow policy and composite-metric automations for safer rollouts. New observability metrics and e2e tests included. No behavioral changes for existing rollouts unless ProbingStage is enabled.
